BUILDPLAN.md T-21 (M4).

`burst` and `smoke` in `test-full`, run against the deployed room in CI; failed-request logging the client can read after a meetup

Criteria: AC-41, AC-52–55
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-09
BUILDPLAN notes: Serialized on `justfile` (`burst`, `test-full`)

Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: DISPATCHED PQ-26 2026-09-30 01:3x EDT by the Orchestrator: inline-full, surface:14 in pane:1, worktree /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/burst-in-ci, branch ai-c11-cc/burst-in-ci off origin/ai-c11-cc/a11y-sweep @ b0dda3e57702f835be9818a469b799dc609f0024 (PQ-16's PR #37, at review, not merged; base it, rebase before your first push only). Boot prompt at the worktree's .claude/boot-prompt.md (templates/gen-wave18.py). Ruling F-39 in the brief: no unattended door to the deployed room exists and none is built - burst on the room's real protocol; burst+smoke in test-full against a room the CI job starts in-process on loopback (labelled loopback); a workflow_dispatch deployed run the client triggers with a fresh organizer session and the admin token as secrets; AC-53's deployed-substrate clause met by that run only; AC-55 as structured failed-request logging plus a per-room summary and a fly logs recipe, canary log scan green. Sibling PQ-27 (copy freeze) runs now off the same branch: you own justfile, .github/workflows/**, room/** except copy.rs and twins.rs, room/README.md. main moved to 1d721f4 (the client's PR #36, bank-only) - no effect on you. Push and gh pr create are the client's Yes in your tab.

Not your files and not your fault; PQ-38 repairs main. Expect your PR's just test job to fail on those pipeline tests until PQ-38 merges and you merge origin/main; judge your own suites locally (just test-room, just test-web, and for PQ-27 the pipeline tests you add) and say so in DONE. Do not touch bank/questions/** or the migration tests.

BLOCKED PQ-26: commit signing fails. The bypassed git commit fails with '1Password: failed to fill whole buffer' (twice), and the approved fallback (ssh-keygen through the 1Password agent socket, key ZmDAi3… listed by ssh-add -l) fails with 'communication with agent failed'. The first commit (burst on the room protocol, shared client, report tests, in-process harness; all green locally) is staged, not committed. Waiting for the client to unlock or approve 1Password.
UNBLOCKED PQ-26: signing works again after the client unlocked 1Password; 13f9817 committed with a Good signature.

CHECKPOINT PQ-26 (usage limit): committed 13f9817 (burst on room protocol, shared room_client, burst_report + tests/burst_report.rs in just test, tests/harness_full.rs loopback: burst@200 exact, smoke@50 pass) and f956ac4 (just burst, PENDING empty, harness-full in test-full, CI client step, deployed-burst.yml). NOT pushed. Next: (d) room/src/requestlog.rs + routes.rs layer + ws.rs drop classification + tests/requestlog.rs + canary_scan line scan; room/README.md (Burst, After a meetup, Deploying/Smoke, spike section); just test-room warm time (baseline 14.0s, 12.8s after first commit); code review; validate; push; PR against main with 'Based on #37'. Plan resolutions in the plan file are authoritative. Note: canary the_binary_logs_no_admin_token flaked once (port race: bind-drop-rebind), passed 3/3 reruns.

DONE PQ-26 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/39 HEAD 0b841e4444fd67348de5a9f8d3d0d91d553b388a BASE b0dda3e57702f835be9818a469b799dc609f0024 test-warm 13.0 deviations: (1) AC-55 lines are plain JSON lines on stderr, not tracing events: tracing is in the lock but no subscriber is, so a tracing event would print nothing without a new crate (F-39-adjacent). (2) The report and decision tests run in just test via an ungated #[path] include of src/bin/burst_report.rs (tests/burst_report.rs); the socket client stays feature-gated, and nothing is added to the lib or the image. (3) The spike's client was renamed spike-burst (frozen, still reproduces the T-03 reports); the new bin burst is feature 'burst' = smoke's TLS client, with no new crate and Cargo.lock unchanged. (4) New files within the cleared scope: room/src/bin/room_client.rs, room/src/bin/burst_report.rs, room/src/requestlog.rs, room/tests/harness_full.rs, room/tests/burst_report.rs, room/tests/requestlog.rs; canary_scan/mod.rs now scans request-log lines for plants. (5) smoke gained --question and --out. The deployed run schedules q3's record under harness ids smoke-q3 and burst-q3 so neither run releases a bank question. (6) The spike's 'more than one Fly machine' invalidity check was dropped: the room exposes no machine id. (7) The CI just test job's smoke step was kept and extended to the burst bin. notes: CI for the PR head is pending as of this comment; the just test job is expected red on the pipeline tests until PQ-38 (per your 01:4x note); room and web suites are green locally. deployed-burst is untriggered: workflow_dispatch needs the file on main, so it can only run after merge; its YAML parses and the AC-64 scan is green. No deployed run is recorded, so AC-53's deployed-substrate clause is open until the client runs it. just test-full cannot finish on this machine (pyenv libintl); its room/web parts pass one at a time, and sandbox-build, test-sandbox and test-verify-full were not run locally. For T-20: popquiz sync must tolerate harness ids (smoke-q3, burst-q3) in GET /admin/used, or the client must restart before syncing (the README and workflow summary both say restart first). Flake seen, not mine: canary the_binary_logs_no_admin_token races on its port (it binds, drops and the child rebinds); one unexplained canary_full failure in a batch loop, 4/4 green since. Code review PASS-WITH-NITS; Major and Minors fixed in 0b841e4.
